rig: procedural (animalModels.js buildHairyWoodpecker, the plain part path as buildWoodpecker): BODY, HEAD (the chisel bill), TAIL, WING_L/R slabs folding on pose. Moved by animals.js on the Steller's jay's machine with HOH `trunk`: it clings to a conifer's bark (pitched up the trunk, facing it, tapping), hops up the trunk, and flies tree to tree.
accuracy_notes: Reads as a black-and-white woodpecker with the white back stripe, the striped face and the male's red nape; primitive shapes (spheres and boxes), no stiff tail feathers braced on the bark, no undulating flight path (the jay machine's flight), no drumming sound.
